assets.name: Game Animation Sample
assets.source: Epic Games Launcher: Unreal Engine > Samples > Game Animation Sample > Create Project
assets.licence: Epic sample content, usable in Unreal Engine projects
assets.installedTo: game/Content/ (Audio, Blueprints, Characters, Input, IsolatedExamples, Levels, MetaHumans, Misc, Movies, Widgets), with game/Config/*.ini and its plugins in Rim3D.uproject
assets.usedFor: character locomotion (motion matching) and the Stage 0 character test
assets.reinstall: Create the sample at C:\Dev\GameAnimationSample, then copy its Content folder over game/Content

assets.name: ImGui (Unreal plugin by VesCodes, bundling Dear ImGui 1.92.8)
assets.installedTo: game/Plugins/ImGui/ (not in Git); enabled in game/Rim3D.uproject, used by the Rim3D module (Rim3D.Build.cs)
assets.usedFor: the overseer's inspect panel and speed controls (U6), later the architect menu and colony panels (U7, U8)
assets.reinstall: git clone https://github.com/VesCodes/ImGui.git game/Plugins/ImGui, then git -C game/Plugins/ImGui checkout 71f29cf675b7d501af4f8e152fb73145f24a3f58

assets.name: Pawn looks (generated)
assets.source: Made by the PawnLooks commandlet from the Game Animation Sample's Kellan and the MetaHuman body type DNA files in the engine's MetaHumanCharacter plugin
assets.licence: Derived from Epic sample content and engine content, usable in Unreal Engine projects
assets.usedFor: body shape morphs on Kellan's body and clothes, our skin material, horns (docs/design/looks.md)
